changelog:
- Updated API references from Gemini 3 Pro to grsai.com Nano Banana Pro.
- Changed required environment variable for API key from GEMINI_API_KEY to GRSAI_API_KEY.
- Added support for setting aspect ratio via --aspect-ratio with several common values.
- Improved troubleshooting section with updated error messages and API failure handling.
- Minor clarifications to output, file saving, and filename generation instructions.
